results.title: Wheelchair User Goes Viral After Climbing Stairs at Train Station — ‘You Can Be in a Wheelchair and Not Need It 100% of the Time’
results.description: A video shared on X has sparked discussion after it showed a wheelchair user navigating a broken elevator and chairlift at a train station. The creator explained that neither the station’s built-in chairlift nor a portable lift worked, leaving her with no option but to climb the stairs despite relying on a wheelchair. The video...
